entities.name: Manila Metropolitan Theatre
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Manila Metropolitan Theater is a historic Philippine Art Deco building located in Plaza Lawton in Ermita, Manila. It is recognized as the forefront of the Art Deco architectural style in the Philippines.
